title: £5 a day → £178,000? The ISA maths nobody shows you #shorts
description:
£5 a day is about £152 a month. Over 30 years you pay in £54,750.
At an assumed 7% a year, the pot could reach £177,854 — and 69% of that is growth, not money you paid in. Inside a Stocks & Shares ISA, you pay no tax on that growth.

Milestones at 7% a year:
• Year 10: £26,014
• Year 20: £77,188
• Year 30: £177,854

Illustration only. 7% a year is an assumption after fees and before inflation. Investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you put in. General education, not financial advice.

Music and sound effects: original, made for this channel.
